findings.title: Raw catalog decodes exhausted cursor Long0 to number0, then rejects it
findings.evidence: catalog.call invokes fixedConnection.db.command(command,{session}) without promoteLongs:false. Its rows loop requires id && typeof id.toString===function. Pinned Mongo4 Db.command creates RunCommandOperation with only supplied options; AbstractOperation resolveBSONOptions(options) defaults promoteLongs/promoteValues true. Pinned BSON4 deserializer converts safe int64 (including zero) to JS number. Exhausted real listCollections/listIndexes cursor therefore reaches id=0 and fails CATALOG_CURSOR. No global supplied connect option changes this command-local default; none sets promoteLongs:false anyway.
findings.impact: QUERY_AND_CATALOG cannot pass on ordinary exhausted native replies, even after the separately held Express import policy is resolved. This is source-derived, not an observed application run.
findings.minimalRemediation: At this bounded raw metadata command boundary request promoteLongs:false explicitly and retain its exact native Long exhausted/nonzero validation and cursor cleanup; add or retain real native exhausted-cursor success evidence before counting catalog success. Do not relax a truthiness check into accepting arbitrary cursor shapes or broaden global runtime options.
